hypothesis: A layered suite consisting of nominal/boundary traces, metamorphic downgrade checks, and an independent exhaustive semantic oracle can expose non-equivalent safety-contract mutants, including a correlated interaction mutant that the first two layers miss.

oracles: baseline nominal, missing-provenance, and unknown-outcome traces
metamorphic downgrade from fully valid to stale, authority-mismatched, and terminal-failure states
separately implemented exhaustive truth-table audit over all 32 states

decision.pass: All candidate decisions match the strict semantic contract; all six mutants are independently shown non-equivalent; every one is killed by at least one declared oracle; the compound interaction mutant survives baseline and metamorphic tests but is killed by exhaustive audit.
decision.fail: Any declared non-equivalent mutant survives all oracles, the candidate violates any state in the finite domain, or raw/inventory/accounting is incomplete.
decision.stop: Source identity, execution, or raw integrity is incomplete.

limits.population: One synthetic five-boolean admission contract and six declared mutants.
limits.container: No Docker/OrbStack invocation is authorized by this freeze; the shared CPU slot must be explicitly assigned in #5085 before any container run.
